title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Your face after a mistake
hook: After a mistake, players look at your face first.
intro: A throw sails over the first baseman.
The player turns to look at the dugout.
statement: Your face answers before your words do.
q1: Do you keep a steady face no matter what —
q2: or show honest reactions so kids know where they stand?
q3: What did your face say last game?
t1: Every coach is different. But kids take risks
cta: Coaches — what does your face say?
ctaLines: A nod. A thumbs up. Honest reactions.
ctaPrompt: Share your dugout habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
After a mistake, players look at your face first.
A throw sails over the first baseman. The player turns to look at the dugout.
Your face answers before your words do.
A steady face or honest reactions. Both can work.
What does your face say? Share your habit in the comments.
